mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_PROJECT A WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'
AND A.PROJ_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
SELECT PROJ_ID AS projId , PROJ_NM AS projNm , PROJ_TYPE AS projType , STATUS AS status , START_DT AS startDt , END_DT AS endDt FROM TB_PROJECT WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId} AND DEL_YN = 'N'
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_PROJECT SET STATUS = #{status} WHERE PROJ_ID = #{projId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_PROJECT_ASSIGN ( PROJECT_ID, USER_ID, ASSIGN_TITLE, START_DATE, END_DATE, INPUT_RATE, LAST_UPDUSR_ID, LAST_UPDT_PNTTM ) VALUES ( #{projectId}, #{userId}, #{assignTitle}, STR_TO_DATE(#{startDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), STR_TO_DATE(#{endDate}, '%Y-%m-%d'), #{inputRate}, #{lastUpdusrId}, NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT A.ASSIGN_ID AS assignId , A.PROJECT_ID AS projectId , A.USER_ID AS userId , B.USER_NM AS userNm , B.DEPT_NM AS deptNm , B.POSITION_NM AS positionNm , A.ASSIGN_TITLE AS assignTitle , DATE_FORMAT(A.START_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate , DATE_FORMAT(A.END_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate , A.INPUT_RATE AS inputRate FROM TB_PROJECT_ASSIGN A INNER JOIN TB_USER B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID WHERE A.PROJECT_ID = #{projectId} AND A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY A.ASSIGN_ID DESC

SELECT IFNULL(MAX(daily_rate), 0) FROM ( SELECT SUM(INPUT_RATE) as daily_rate FROM TB_PROJECT_ASSIGN WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND DEL_YN = 'N' AND NOT (END_DATE < #{startDate} OR START_DATE > #{endDate}) GROUP BY USER_ID ) AS temp

SELECT A.USER_ID AS userId , A.USER_NM AS userNm , A.DEPT_NM AS deptNm , A.POSITION_NM AS positionNm , (SELECT IFNULL(SUM(SUB.INPUT_RATE), 0) FROM TB_PROJECT_ASSIGN SUB WHERE TRIM(SUB.USER_ID) = TRIM(A.USER_ID) COLLATE utf8mb4_general_ci AND SUB.DEL_YN = 'N' AND CURDATE() BETWEEN SUB.START_DATE AND SUB.END_DATE ) AS currentLoad FROM TB_USER A WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'
AND A.USER_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchNm}, '%')
ORDER BY A.USER_NM ASC
